segments.name: Immersion
segments.description: Licenses patented haptic technology so device makers, content and platform companies can build touch-based experiences for end users.
segments.evidence: Following the closing of the Transactions (as defined below) with Barnes & Noble Education, we operate our business in two operating segments: Immersion and Barnes & Noble Education.

segments.name: Barnes & Noble Education
segments.description: Operates physical and virtual campus bookstores and wholesales textbooks and inventory management systems to colleges, schools and students.
segments.evidence: Barnes & Noble Education is one of the largest contract operators of physical and virtual bookstores for college and university campuses and K-12 institutions across the United States.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay Immersion licensing fees and per-unit royalties for its patented haptics; students and campuses pay Barnes & Noble Education for course materials, rentals and merchandise.
revenueModel.evidence: We have adopted a business model under which we offer licenses that allow our customers to integrate Immersion's patented technology into their products.

changes.text: In 2024 the company acquired a controlling interest in Barnes & Noble Education, adding a second reportable segment alongside Immersion.
changes.evidence: In June 2024, Immersion acquired a controlling interest in Barnes & Noble Education, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Barnes & Noble Education").
